mission.title: Invention
mission.description: Have a little chat with Mercury about the workers he is sending into the subway, and check up on the Blackwoods in Magog.

npc.say: Uh... I'll just get back to work on my device, then...
If we can get this thing working, it will be a revolution in personal hygiene.
Uh-oh. Where did I leave those thermal conductors?
We'll keep an eye on mister Mercury.
Damn it, who forgot to lock the door?
What's this Merv goon doing here?
I got a little bored watching Mercury, you know.
Gah! I can't get any work done with you people dragging your knuckles through here.
Hey, have you seen where I put that cheat code vi-- Oh. Uh...never mind.

phase.briefing:
It seems that Mercury is up to something. We're not sure what, but as Silver informed us, he is indeed sending workers out of his usual domain, Uriah, and into the subway in Tabor Park, from whence they depart for parts unknown.
We will have to demonstrate to him that we do not like business being conducted without the Merovingian's approval, non? Go have a little chat with him.

enter.say: Got some Exile signals in there. Should be Mercury, and maybe some assistants.

talk.say:
Silver! That hack! What does he know? Is using public transportation a crime? My men have to get parts for my work!
Look, I've heard rumors the others are planning something. If you ask me, Thallia's got to be involved. The Blackwoods have been mugging just about everyone who sets foot in Magog, and they wouldn't go to all that trouble without being put up to it by somebody; and who else thinks they're the boss in Magog? Thallia!
I'm telling you, go check it out. They'll start causing trouble in Uriah, next, and neither of us wants that.

done.say: Hm. We'd better go see what Flood wants us to do.

phase.briefing: Really, operative, do you need me to hold your hand through everything? Get over to Magog and check up on those Blackwoods!

enter.say: I've got Exile signals in there. Looks like Flood knew where to find some Blackwoods.

done.say: --- reading new message --- ...meeting at Mjolnir. Always nice to see the boys assembled. Remember what we talked about, and have them ready for next time. Be in touch. --- end of message ---
Huh. I'm gonna run a trace on that message.

near.say: Damn it, who forgot to lock the door?
What's this Merv goon doing here?

phase.briefing: That message you found may have sounded innocuous, {player}, but I wouldn't trust those Blackwoods farther than I could throw them. Our contacts confirm that their activity has increased lately, and it is causing trouble for our business interests in the area.

done.say: No more hostile signals in there.

talk.say: I got a little bored watching Mercury, you know.

done.say: Yeah, well, aside from our albino buddy there, my scan isn't showing anything unusual in the area.

phase.briefing: Hm. I like dead ends almost as little as I like you, {player}. This is quite unsatisfactory. No, I think Mercury is going to have to do better than this. Pay him another visit.

enter.say: Flood needs to rearrange his room so he can get up on the right side of the bed once in a while.

talk.say:
What, am I responsible for Thallia's schemes now? It's not my fault you couldn't find--
Okay, okay! Fine. I'll help you out, all right? I'll get in touch with Flood, and we'll set something up.

done.say: Oh, good. That lets me off the hook.

near.say: He doesn't even have a hookah in this place.

mission.finish: Passing the buck, are you, {player}? I should have expected it. Mercury's obviously too clever for you--not that that's saying much. Very well; if you'll excuse me, I have arrangements to make.
